body:
Running the MRP with `--gpu-validation` and using DebugView, i get the following errors before the crash: ``` D3D12 ERROR: ID3D12Device::CreateUnorderedAccessView: When creating a RAW Shader Resource View, the offset of the first element from the start of the buffer must be a multiple of 16 bytes. Thus, FirstElement (1) must be a multiple of 4 since each element is 4 bytes. [ STATE_CREATION ERROR #345: CREATEUNORDEREDACCESSVIEW_INVALIDDIMENSIONS] D3D12 ERROR: ID3D12Device::RemoveDevice: Device removal has been triggered for the following reason (DXGI_ERROR_INVALID_CALL: There is strong evidence that the application has performed an illegal or undefined operation, and such a condition could not be returned to the application cleanly through a return code). [ EXECUTION ERROR #232: DEVICE_REMOVAL_PROCESS_AT_FAULT] D3D12 ERROR: ID3D12CommandList::ClearUnorderedAccessViewUint: The CPU and GPU descriptor handles refer to unmatched descriptors. ClearUnorderedAccessView* methods require that the GPU and CPU descriptor handles reside in separate shader-visible and non-shader-visible descriptor heaps resptively. These descriptors must otherwise be identical. [ EXECUTION ERROR #646: INVALID_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE] D3D12 ERROR: ID3D12CommandList::ClearUnorderedAccessViewUint: Descriptor (at CPU Handle 0x000002003432C180) which has an underlying stale or released resource is invalid for use. [ EXECUTION ERROR #1042: DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE_WITH_INVALID_RESOURCE] ```
From the first two errors seems that's how D3D12 operates, so the offset needs to follow the 16 bytes alignment. Would be good if we could add a check to handle it more gracefully if possible. Pinging @blueskythlikesclouds to see if there's something that can be done about it.

Ah, I posted this in rc on the rendering channel, but apparently didn't mention it here.

I have little experience working with dx12 (more used to OpenGL and Vulkan) but looking at the docs I suspect we could have an UAV that is 16 aligned and then use the optional rect Parameter of the clear command to only clear what we actually want to clear.

However, I would like to get confirmation from someone who is more familiar with DX that doing so won't have any unintended side effects or cause a performance regression before I try to throw together a PR.
